description: Fund flows as ETFIQ publishes them, computed from each fund's daily change in shares outstanding times its NAV. With ticker: that fund's net flow over 1D, 1W, 1M, 3M, YTD and 1Y, each with its dates and its share of net assets at the window's start, its streak, and its filed N-PORT months. Without ticker: the biggest inflows and outflows among every fund with daily data for window (1D, 1W, 1M, 3M, YTD or 1Y; default 1W), how many funds were counted, each row with the last day its numbers reach (through; a row short of the window counts fewer days), and the latest weekly flows report (Monday to Friday) with its own top inflows and outflows, each with its days. Filter by desk, category (Stocks, Bonds, Commodities, Allocation) or issuer. It answers questions about money going into or out of ETFs.

category.description: Optional: only funds in this category. Ignored when ticker is given.

desk.description: Optional: only funds on this desk, such as leverage. Ignored when ticker is given.

issuer.description: Optional: only funds from this issuer. Ignored when ticker is given.

limit.description: Most rows in each ranked list, 1 to 50. Default 10.

ticker.description: Optional: one fund's flows, such as SPY. Omit for the ranked inflows and outflows of every fund.

window.description: The window the flows cover. Default 1W.

name: etf_flows

as_of.description: Date of the newest number in the answer.

citation.description: A ready citation string with the as-of date and the page address.

data.description: The answer, or null when ETFIQ refuses (then error and reason say why).

disclaimer_required.description: True when the answer carries numbers that need the not-advice line.

error.description: Present only on a refusal: what ETFIQ does not publish.

provenance.description: Where each number came from: field, source, as_of, source_uri.

reason.description: Present only on a refusal: why, and what to change.

tried.description: Present only on a refusal: what was looked up.

warnings.description: Caveats to show with the answer.
